headline: Contested Belt Reports Fresh Frontline Movement
war_summary: The latest returns show fresh movement in the principal contested belt, though most sectors remain quiet in the immediate ledger. Palantine Berm has become the liveliest front, with four events in the last two hours and 29 across the day; its holdings now stand six Warden to one Colonial. Callahan’s Passage also records three recent events and 14 over 24 hours, while retaining a nine-Warden, one-Colonial balance. Since the previous edition, Stlican Shelf is now five Colonial to three Warden with one neutral base, and Nevish Line stands evenly divided at four and four; neither reports a fresh event in the latest two-hour window. Weathered Expanse remains heavily fought over in the broader account, with 35 events and a seven-Colonial, two-Warden split, but no recent activity. Kuura Strand likewise has 14 daily events, though its latest action came earlier and all six bases remain Warden-held. Elsewhere the ownership ledgers are largely settled, and the war records no victor.
